contextPath.description:

coreSolutionRepos.description:
Identifies the repositories holding the `code` role.

These repos are owned by the team and will have code written to them. They must be local repos on disk to allow for the full development experience. In a single-repo topology, list the one repository here (the same one listed under `prism`).

contextRepos.description: Context repos are read-only repos used for product context.
